about_the_game:
Astralith is a mutiplayer RPG where every character truly stands on their own. Collect dozens of spells and weapons, customize your character, and battle against other players all striving to reach the Astralith. Play a traveler in the woods, a merchant in the city, a mage in a tower, or even a king if you dare to reach for a throne.

  • Spellcraft: Collect spells as you level up to create unique combinations.

  • Personalization: Pick from a number of races to start with and dress them to appear just as you like.

  • Permadeath: Beware! Astralith takes death seriously, and if your character dies, they're dead for good.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
